newsitem.title: USA: Maxxam offers to exchange notes.
newsitem.headline: Maxxam offers to exchange notes.

text.p: Maxxam Inc said Friday that its subsidiary, Maxxam Group Holdings Inc, has offered to exchange its 12 percent Series B senior secured notes for any and all of the $130 million principal amount outstanding of its 12 percent senior secured notes.
The notes involved in the exchange are due 2003.
The company said it will accept for exchange any and all 12 percent senior secured notes tendered before 1700 EST on February 10.
Maxxam is involved in the aluminium, forest products and real estate industries.
